name: Meta WhatsApp - Perfil e Dados Conexao

parameters.content:
## Perfil + Dados da Conexao

**URL:** POST /webhook/meta-perfil

### atualizar
Campos editaveis (Meta): about (1-139), description (1-512), address (1-256), email, vertical (enum), websites (max 2, https://).
POST: `/{phone_number_id}/whatsapp_business_profile` com `messaging_product: whatsapp`.
Foto: JPG min 192x192 via Resumable Upload + profile_picture_handle (request separado).

Display name (nome de exibicao): consultar/sincronizar retorna `nomeStatus`, `novoNomeExibir`, `novoNomeStatus`. Para alterar use workflow `meta-display-name`.
